test_cases.title: Non-empty search value debounces 300ms before firing request
test_cases.given: the admin has focused the dashboard search input and no request has fired yet
test_cases.when: the admin types a non-empty value into the search input
test_cases.then: getUsers({ search, role, status }) is not called until 300ms of fake-timer time has elapsed, then is called exactly once with the typed value

test_cases.title: Clearing the search input triggers an immediate (0ms) refetch
test_cases.given: the admin has a non-empty search value entered and results are filtered
test_cases.when: the admin clears the search input to an empty string
test_cases.then: getUsers is called immediately (0ms delay) with an empty/omitted search param, without waiting for the 300ms debounce

test_cases.title: Search matches case-insensitively across name, email, and phone
test_cases.given: users Alice Example (alice@test.com, phone 5551234567) and Bob Example exist
test_cases.when: GET /api/users?search=ALICE is requested
test_cases.then: the response contains only the user whose name, email, or phone matches 'alice' case-insensitively (Alice), and excludes Bob

test_cases.title: Empty search term returns the full unfiltered, paginated user list
test_cases.given: multiple users exist and a search filter was previously applied
test_cases.when: the search value becomes empty and GET /api/users is requested with no search param
test_cases.then: the response returns the full unfiltered user list within the existing pagination envelope (default page size 50)

test_cases.title: Search term matching no user returns an empty result set, not an error
test_cases.given: no user in the system has 'zzz-nomatch' in name, email, or phone
test_cases.when: GET /api/users?search=zzz-nomatch is requested
test_cases.then: the response is 200 OK with an empty results array and total=0, not a 404 or 500

test_cases.title: Backend regression suite passes after test-infrastructure fix
test_cases.given: the import-shadowing fix in backend/tests/test_users.py:13 is applied
test_cases.when: the full pytest suite is run
test_cases.then: all 15 backend tests pass, including test_search_filters_by_name_email_phone

test_cases.title: GET /api/users search response time stays within performance budget
test_cases.given: GET /api/users?search=<term> is exercised at sustained load
test_cases.when: 50 RPS is sustained for 60 seconds against a seeded dataset
test_cases.then: p95 response latency is below 300ms

attempts.reason: no load-testing runner (k6/locust) exists in this repo

test_cases.then: the request succeeds with 200 OK, confirming the documented open-endpoint behavior has not silently changed

test_cases.then: it has aria-label="Search users" attribute present
